rules: R6 overrides every conflicting historical value
Unfrozen parking/service facilities without permanent IDs are excluded
Undergraduate dorm footprints remain a 78-82m range; no silent midpoint is chosen before its footprint policy is explicitly resolved
External roads and perimeter wall reuse the authoritative R6 files instead of duplicating a second coordinate set
SVG coordinate mapping is frozen and may not auto-fit current geometry
One world meter equals one SVG user unit inside the map frame
World X maps right; world Z maps upward by inversion into SVG Y
Presentation profile may translate the map group but may not scale it
Perimeter wall openings are true geometry gaps computed from frozen gate/interface targets
External and internal road source centerlines remain data-driven; visual line joins do not create alternate engineering coordinates
PATH-CHENGHU is derived only from the frozen WATER-LAKE-01 shoreline using the source rule: outward offset 25m, closed loop
Only WATER-LAKE-01 has a frozen shoreline in Step 4; other named water bodies are drawn as explicitly marked area-equivalent reference circles from source center + area
Squares without frozen footprint geometry are center markers only
Parks without frozen boundary geometry are reference envelopes/circles only and must not be treated as final landscape boundaries
Boya lawn uses its source control envelope and remains subject to later landscape refinement
No raster image elements are permitted in generated masterplan SVG files
nextStep: Step 5: generate all current building footprints, 56 residences and outdoor sports facilities into the frozen SVG layers without changing Step 4 road/water geometry.
